descriptionHtml: IEEE Andaharaya is a membership awareness program initiated by the Member Activities Sub-Committee of the IEEE Student Activities Committee of IEEE Sri Lanka Section. This event is held in every student branch across the island to expand the IEEE community. The event provides an opportunity for all the members to learn about the benefits of IEEE membership and share experience at IEEE events
